client timeout

Slack went 10 seconds without answering, or the connection to it failed, so whether the message was posted is unknown. Check the DM's history (list_channels shows its id, and fetch_history its messages) before posting again, so it isn't posted twice.

bad gateway

Slack answered with HTTP 502, so whether the message was posted is unknown. Check the DM's history (list_channels shows its id, and fetch_history its messages) before posting again, so it isn't posted twice.

unreadable answer

Slack's answer, if one came, couldn't be read, so whether the message was posted is unknown. Check the DM's history (list_channels shows its id, and fetch_history its messages) before posting again, so it isn't posted twice.

chat.postMessage: the answer named no message in D1

Slack's answer to the post named no message, so whether the message was posted is unknown. Check the DM's history (list_channels shows its id, and fetch_history its messages) before posting again, so it isn't posted twice.

post refused

Nothing was sent: Slack doesn't know the conversation, or this bot can't see it. The id may be mistyped or remembered rather than copied, or it's a private conversation this bot isn't in. list_channels shows the conversations this bot can use, with their ids.

post refused

Nothing was sent: Slack is rate-limiting this kind of call for the workspace, and asks to wait 20 seconds before trying again.

client timeout

Nothing was sent: Slack couldn't be reached. Try again shortly. If it keeps failing, whoever runs this host has to check its connection to Slack.

client timeout

Slack went 10 seconds without answering, or the connection to it failed, so whether the message was posted is unknown. Check the DM's history (list_channels shows its id, and fetch_history its messages) before posting again, so it isn't posted twice.
